αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg.: ’of himself, him’ · also the adverb αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot’
αὐτός: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’he himself’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg., reinforcing a pronoun: ’me myself’ (ἔμ’ αὐτὸν) · also plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν ’beside him’)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βάλε: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλε): ’threw, dashed’
βασιλήων: βασιλεύς — king; masc. gen. pl., epic -ήων (= Attic -έων)
βασιλεύς: βασιλεύς — king, chief; masc. nom. sg.
βασιλῆα: βασιλεύς — king; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic βασιλέα)
βουλάς: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. acc. pl.
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γέρας: γέρας — prize of honour, privilege, due portion; neut. nom./acc. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
δάκρυ: δάκρυ — tear, tears; neut. acc. sg., object of χέω: ’shedding tears’
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δίῳ: δῖος — bright, noble, divine (epic epithet); masc. dat. sg.
διοτρεφέων: διοτρεφής — Zeus-nurtured; masc. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -ῶν)
διός: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; gen. sg. (stem Δι-)
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶκε: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔδωκε)
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question · εἰ δή ’if indeed, since’ · also εἰ δ’ ἄγε ’come now’, a hortatory idiom
εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
εἷς: εἷς — one; numeral, masc. nom. sg.
εὖτ: εὖτε (elided εὖτ’) — when, whenever; temporal conj. (with ἄν + subj.)
ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θέμιστας: θέμις — custom, established right, ordinance; fem. acc. pl.: ’ordinances, customary rights’
θοὰς: θοός — swift, quick; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with νῆας: ’swift (ships)’
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κάθησο: κάθημαι — sit; pres. imper. 2 sg. κάθησο: ’sit!’
κάκ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc./nom. pl., elided (κάκ’ = κακά): ’evils, misfortunes’
κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ (κάρη κομόωντας ’long-haired’)
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · with αἴ + subj.: ’if perhaps’ · with a relative + fut. indic.: ’who will, in that event’
καθ: κατά (elided καθ’) — down, down to; prep. + acc., aspirated before rough breathing (καθ’ ἕδρας ’down to their seats’)
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil, harmful; neut. acc. sg.
κακῶν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. pl.: ’of ills, of misfortunes’
κακῶς: κακός — bad, evil; adv.: ’wickedly, shamefully’ · also ’miserably, in misery’ (ὀψὲ κακῶς ἔλθοι ’may he come late, in misery’)
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη)
κλισιάων: κλισίη — hut, shelter; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic κλισιῶν)
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the people’
λωβήσαιο: λωβάομαι — outrage, insult, act with outrage; aor. opt. 2 sg. mid., with ἄν: ’you would commit outrage’
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, by all means; adv.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’
μέγας: μέγας — great, big; masc. nom. sg.
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; truly; particle, often answered by δέ; acute before an enclitic; ἦ μέν ’truly’ in oaths
μή: μή — not; the negative of wish, command, fear and condition (where οὐ is the negative of fact) · also ’lest’, with the subj.
μακρὰ: μακρός — long, tall; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἕρματα · also agreeing with κύματα: ’tall (waves)’
μηδ: μηδέ — and not, nor; conj., elided (μηδ’ = μηδέ), with an imperative: ’and do not’
μητίετα: μητίετα — counsellor, wise in counsel (epithet of Zeus); masc. nom. sg., epic -α
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μυρί: μυρίος — countless, numberless; neut. acc. pl., elided (μυρί’ = μυρία)
μύθῳ: μῦθος — word, speech, plea; masc. dat. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
νεῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl. (= epic νηῶν)
νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
ξυνέηκε: συνίημι — bring together, set together; aor. 3 sg., old spelling ξυν- (= συν-), epic -έηκε (= συνῆκε)
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’
οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg., correlative of τοῖος (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτέ: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj., accented οὔτέ before an enclitic
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πατρώϊον: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, ancestral; neut. acc. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
ποιμένα: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. acc. sg. (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’, apposition)
ποιμένι: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. dat. sg., in the standing royal title ποιμὴν λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’
πολλά: πολύς — much, many; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’many’ · also adverbial: ’much’
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’
πολυφλοίσβοιο: πολύφλοισβος — loud-roaring; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
πτολίεθρον: πτολίεθρον — citadel, city; neut. acc. sg., epic lengthened by-form of πόλις
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόποι: πόποι — in ὦ πόποι, exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! alas!’; origin unknown
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’
σκήπτρῳ: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre; neut. dat. sg.
σκῆπτρον: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre (badge of the right to speak); neut. acc. sg.
στρατόν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl., ’those things’; accented before an enclitic
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τετελεσμένον: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἔσται: ’shall stand fulfilled’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’)
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τροίῃ: Τροίη — Troy; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic Τροίᾳ)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. sg.: ’this’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (αἰσχρὸν τόδε ἐστί)
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’)
υἷας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἷας (= Attic υἱούς)
υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear’
φρεσίν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φῶτα: φώς — man, mortal; masc. acc. sg.
χαλκοχιτώνων: χαλκοχίτων — bronze-shirted, with bronze tunics; masc. gen. pl.
χόλος: χόλος — anger, wrath; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγαμέμνονα: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. acc. sg.
ἀγαμέμνονι: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. dat. sg.
ἀγανοῖς: ἀγανός — gentle, soothing; masc./neut. dat. pl., attributive: ἀγανοῖς ἐπέεσσιν ’with gentle words’
ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.
ἀγορητής: ἀγορητής — speaker, orator; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγορὴν: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering place; acc. sg. (Ionic for Attic ἀγορά)
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’)
ἀπούρας: ἀπαυράω — take away from, rob of; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. ἀπούρας (a defective verb)
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀργείοισιν: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀτρεΐδη: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. voc. sg.
ἀτρεΐδῃ: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic, of Agamemnon); masc. dat. sg.
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλῆα: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. acc. sg., epic Ἀχιλῆα (= Attic Ἀχιλλέα)
ἀχιλῆϊ: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. dat. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλεῖ)
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄπο: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (νεῶν ἄπο ’from the ships’)
ἄποινα: ἄποινα — ransom (a neuter plural noun); nom./acc. pl.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄριστον: ἀγαθός — good; superl. ἄριστος, masc. acc. sg.: ’best’
ἄφθιτον: ἄφθιτος — imperishable, undying; neut. acc. sg.
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκπάγλως: ἔκπαγλος — terrible, vehement; adv. ἐκπάγλως: ’terribly, mightily’
ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — in this place, to this place; adv.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’)
ἐπέεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπεσσεύοντο: ἐπισεύομαι — hurry on, rush to; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐπεσεύοντο): ’hastened on’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐρήτυθεν: ἐρητύω — hold back, restrain; aor. 3 pl. pass., epic -θεν (= Attic ἠρητύθησαν): ’were held back’
ἐριζέμεναι: ἐρίζω — strive, contend (with + dat.); pres. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἐρίζειν)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist (= ἔβη): ’went’
ἔθελ: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἔθελ’ = ἔθελε)
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen. · also preverb in tmesis (ἔκ … ἐρέω = ἐξερέω ’I shall speak out’)
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔοικε: ἔοικα — be fitting, seem; perf. with pres. sense, impersonal 3 sg.: ’it is fitting’
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἔστω: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let there be, let him be’
ἔχει: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 sg. · also intransitive with an adverb, ’be in a state’: εὖ … κομιδὴ ἔχει ’the tending is in good order’
ἔχθιστος: ἔχθιστος — most hateful; superl. of ἐχθρός, masc. nom. sg.
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠτίμησεν: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, slight; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (ἠτίμησε(ν))
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’
ἥρωες: ἥρως — hero; masc. voc. pl. (same as nom.), in address: ’heroes!’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα
ἦε: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), spelled ἦε
ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves 3 pl.): ’I came’
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰλίου: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. gen. sg.
ἴδμεν: οἶδα — know; pres. 1 pl., epic ἴδμεν (= Attic ἴσμεν): ’we know’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴσχεο: ἴσχω — hold, restrain; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic ἴσχου): ’restrain yourself, hold back’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj.
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὀνείδεα: ὄνειδος — reproach, taunt, blame; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀνείδη)
ὀνειδείοις: ὀνείδειος — abusive, reproachful; neut. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσιν
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in such a way that; conj. + fut. indic.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὑπόδρα: ὑπόδρα — with a scowl, ’from under the brows’ (ancient explanation; derivation uncertain); adv.
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’)
ὕστατα: ὕστατος — last; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’for the last time’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’
ὤμοισιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.)
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ᾔδη: οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 sg. with past sense (= impf.): ’knew’
ᾗσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= ἑῇσιν)
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
